question: Across renewal-maintenance QLIs, how many carry a Type=Renew QuoteAction vs null; and do the failing BoKS accounts own RNM-PIAMBK but no RRM-PIAM while the one passing account owns a real RRM asset (adjudicate H3 SKU-mismatch)?
finding: H3 STRONGLY CONFIRMED (with a sharpening refinement). Population: org-wide there are 498,251 Renewal-Maintenance QLIs (Fortra_Product_Type__c='Renewal Maintenance'); exactly 1 carries a QuoteActionId and 498,250 are QuoteActionId=null. The single QA-bearing line is the CONTROL 0QLWC000003dEW24AM (quote 0Q0WC00000382MH0AY / Nir DPP Test 2), whose linked QuoteAction 7ocWC00000u7yf8YAA is Type='Renew' and which commits NetUnitPrice=67.38=COLACalculatedPrice__c=67.38. Scoped to BoKS RRM (PIA-PIA-RRM-PIAM, 01tWC00000DD1buYAD): 124 QLIs total, 123 QA-null, 1 QA-present. Asset inventory across the 4 BoKS accounts (direct rows): Nir DPP Test 2 (001WC00000kZKNxYAO, PASSING 67.38) is the ONLY account owning a PIA-PIA-RRM-PIAM asset (02iWC000008GKPaYAO, Installed) in addition to RNM-PIAMBK + NRPS-PIAP. The three FAILING accounts own RNM-PIAMBK + NRPS-PIAP but ZERO RRM-PIAM: BoKS IAM Test (001WC00000kTYyNYAW, canary 60.64 + a $0 line) = 1 RNM + 1 NRPS + 0 RRM; DPP New Nir (001WC00000kR6BnYAK, $0) = 6 RNM + 6 NRPS + 0 RRM; DPP Test 1 (001WC00000kVpYeYAK, 54.58) = 1 RNM + 1 NRPS + 0 RRM. Causal chain proven: the passing Type='Renew' QuoteAction's SourceAssetId is exactly the RRM-PIAM asset 02iWC000008GKPaYAO. Mechanism confirmed in LIVE COLAUpliftHandler.handleBeforeInsert (LMD 2026-06-10T16:29:57Z, matches repo copy): QA-null lines short-circuit at L29-31 (quoteActionIds.isEmpty -> return, never get born-net COLA); the QuoteAction query is gated WHERE Type='Renew' at L39; map-empty short-circuits at L42-44. So a configurator-auto-added RRM line with no QuoteAction never enters the born-net 67.38 path. REFINEMENT correcting a crude reading of H3: 'has a Renew QuoteAction' is NOT the discriminator - DPP Test 1 DOES have a Type='Renew' QuoteAction (7ocWC00000u7tqlYAA) yet its BoKS line still fails, because that QA renews VM-BSL-RSL-BESECB (beSECURE), not a BoKS RRM asset. Nir DPP Test 2 has 2 Renew QAs (HRM-HRM-RSL-10L50CS and PIA-PIA-RRM-PIAM); only the RRM-sourced one feeds the BoKS line. The true discriminator = the account owns a PIA-PIA-RRM-PIAM asset, which initiateRenewal can SKU-match into a Renew QuoteAction on the BoKS renewal line. H3 'customers own RNM-PIAMBK but the renewal line uses RRM-PIAM -> initiateRenewal can't SKU-match -> RRM line auto-added without a QuoteAction' is exactly what the data shows.
